hub.speaker: Goblin Warband
hub.text: The goblins fan out across the road, blades low. One eyes your gear, weighing something.

options.text: Stand aside. I've killed things bigger than your whole warband. (Warrior)

backdown.speaker: Goblin Warband
backdown.text: A long pause. The lead goblin sniffs, spits, and waves the others off the road. They keep their eyes on you until the corner.
